evidence.quoted_text:
if inventory[unit]["service_type"] == "simple":
            self.refuse("simple service completion has no declared execution "
                        "bound; preflight refuses this topology")
        service_timeout = inventory[unit]["service_timeout_seconds"]
evidence.reason: The preflight only refuses service_type == "simple"; a bounded Type=oneshot service with RemainAfterExit=yes is accepted. After the explicit start such a service remains active, so the restored timer cannot start it again and cannot produce the second strictly advancing completion that _completion_budget requires. Refusing this topology in preflight is a routine correctness fix in the existing completion-bound logic, not a new protection requirement.
